title: Besimple AI (YC P25) Is Hiring
summary: Besimple AI, a Y Combinator Winter 2025 batch startup, is hiring a Strategic Projects Lead for Audio Data to manage strategic initiatives related to audio data processing, collection, and quality assurance for their AI systems.
problem_solved: This job posting addresses the hiring need for managing strategic audio data projects at an AI startup building with audio data.
why_valuable: Provides an opportunity to join an early-stage YC-backed AI company and lead strategic initiatives in the growing audio AI space.
